mapper.select: select p.post_seq, p.board_type, p.category, p.member_seq, m.login_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.recommend_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, case when p.board_type = 'ANON' then '익명' else m.nickname end as writer_name, case when p.board_type= 'ANON' then null else (select max(pi.file_url) keep (dense_rank first order by pi.sort_order) from profile_image pi where pi.member_seq = p.member_seq and pi.review_status = 'APPROVED') end as profile_image_url from post p join member m on p.member_seq = m.member_seq where p.post_seq = #{postSeq} and p.is_deleted = 'N'
